about.title: From the classroom to architecture
about.p1: I'm from Pernambuco, Brazil. I studied Mathematics and taught it before becoming a developer. The classroom taught me to explain complex things simply, and that's what I try to do with code: clear, documented systems that are easy to maintain.
about.p2: Today I'm a software architect at ONR, helping teams set standards, integrate systems and clarify concepts day to day. Before that, at Apex NFT, I worked on Castles NFT, one of the most popular games on the WAX blockchain, and gave a talk on NFTs and crypto at SEBRAE's booth at Trakto Show.
about.p3: I'm an open source enthusiast, which is why so many of my projects are local tools with no account and no cloud, that anyone can clone and run.
about.education: Education: B.Ed. in Mathematics, UPE (2017–2021) · Systems Analysis and Development, Estácio (2024–2026)
